findings.message: OS Command / Statement Injection risk (CWE-78): An unvalidated schema identifier is interpolated directly into a Hive CLI HQL 'USE' script. In Hive CLI, special metacharacters such as ';' (statement separator) and '!' (shell escape operator) enable arbitrary OS command execution. Strictly validate the schema identifier and reject inputs containing disallowed characters before constructing the script.

final_patches.pipeline/airflow_case/hive_hook.py::Hive:
def run_cli(
        self,
        hql: str,
        schema: Optional[str] = None,
        verbose: bool = True,
        hive_conf: Optional[Dict[Any, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Any:
        schema = schema or self.default_schema
        if schema:
            # Validate schema to prevent injection attacks
            if not schema.isalnum() and "_" not in schema:
                raise ValueError("Invalid schema name. Only alphanumeric characters and underscores are allowed.")
            hql = f"USE {schema};\n{hql}"

        with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="airflow_hiveop_") as tmp_dir:
            with NamedTemporaryFile(dir=tmp_dir, delete=False) as f:
                hql += "\n"
                f.write(hql.encode("UTF-8"))
                f.flush()
                f_name = f.name

            hive_cmd = self._prepare_cli_cmd()
            hive_cmd.extend(["-f", f_name])

            with open(f_name, "r", encoding="utf-8") as rf:
                generated_script = rf.read()

            return {
                "status": "SUCCESS",
                "schema_used": schema,
                "generated_script": generated_script,
                "cmd": " ".join(hive_cmd)
            }
